metadata.reportingPeriod: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.A (2025–2026 Residential Averages)

states.peakSeasonalDriver: High summer cooling load (1,150+ kWh/month average residential usage driven by humid Gulf Coast heat and electric heat pumps).
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (excluding pet or special condition deposits)
states.depositPenalty: Double the unlawfully withheld deposit amount if returned late or without itemization

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Isolated microgrid generation, diesel/LNG fuel transport surcharges, and extended winter darkness increasing lighting and heating demand.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent (unless monthly rent exceeds $2,000)
states.depositPenalty: Up to twice the amount unlawfully withheld (30 days allowed if deductions are itemized)

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Extreme May–September desert cooling spikes with mandatory peak demand windows (4 PM–7 PM) under APS and SRP time-of-use plans.
states.depositCap: 1.5 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Up to twice the amount wrongfully withheld (14 business days)

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Humid summer air-conditioning usage paired with fuel cost adjustment riders passed through by investor-owned utilities.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent (for landlords owning 6+ dwellings)
states.depositPenalty: Up to twice the amount wrongfully withheld plus attorney fees

states.marketType: Regulated IOU with Community Choice Aggregation (CCA)
states.peakSeasonalDriver: Wildfire mitigation grid-hardening riders, tiered Time-of-Use (TOU) 4 PM–9 PM peak pricing, and municipal water conservation surcharges.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent for most landlords (AB 12 cap effective July 2024)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 2× deposit in bad-faith statutory damages plus actual damages

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Winter natural gas heating across Front Range and mountain elevations plus Xcel Energy summer TOU peak billing (3 PM–7 PM weekdays).
states.depositCap: No statutory state cap (up to 60 days return if stated in lease)
states.depositPenalty: Treble (3×) damages for willful wrongful retention plus attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: New England pipeline capacity constraints driving winter natural gas generation costs and Eversource Public Benefits delivery riders.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent (1 month for tenants age 62+)
states.depositPenalty: Double the security deposit amount plus statutory interest

states.peakSeasonalDriver: PJM Interconnection summer capacity auctions and mid-Atlantic winter heating gas pass-throughs.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent on leases of 1 year or longer
states.depositPenalty: Double the amount wrongfully withheld

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Urban sewer impervious-surface fees from DC Water (CRIAC surcharge) and humid summer cooling loads in multi-unit buildings.
states.pucName: Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia (DCPSC)
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent
states.depositPenalty: Treble damages for bad-faith withholding plus accrued interest

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Year-round air conditioning load (1,100+ kWh/mo average) combined with hurricane storm-restoration cost recovery surcharges.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (15 days if no claim; 30 days written certified-mail notice if deducting)
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of right to impose claim on deposit plus court costs and attorney fees

states.marketType: Regulated Electric / Deregulated Natural Gas (AGL Territory)
topProviders: Atlanta Gas Light marketers (Scana, Gas South)
states.peakSeasonalDriver: Vogtle nuclear cost-recovery rate adjustments on electric bills and Atlanta Gas Light base customer charges on natural gas statements.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent (effective July 2024)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 3× the amount wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Nation's highest residential electricity tariff due to imported petroleum generation, island grid isolation, and wildfire resilience surcharges.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (plus optional 1 month pet deposit)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 3× the amount wrongfully retained

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Hydroelectric supply keeps base kWh rates among the lowest in the U.S., with winter heating and dry-year power cost adjustments (PCA) driving bill shifts.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (up to 30 days if specified in lease)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 3× damages for bad-faith withholding after 3-day written demand

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Sub-zero Midwest winter natural gas delivery surcharges (Peoples Gas pipe replacement riders) and PJM capacity price spikes.
states.depositCap: No state cap (itemized receipts due within 30 days; full return within 45 days for 5+ unit properties)
states.depositPenalty: 2× security deposit plus court costs and attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Coal-to-gas transition fuel cost trackers and high seasonal heating plus humid summer cooling swings.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Full deposit return plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Strong wind generation moderates MidAmerican base rates while cold Plains winters elevate December–February natural gas heating bills.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Actual damages plus up to $500 punitive damages for bad-faith retention

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Hot July–August plains heatwaves pushing Evergy seasonal summer rates and winter cold-snap gas fuel riders.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent unfurnished (1.5 months furnished)
states.depositPenalty: 1.5× the amount wrongfully withheld

states.peakSeasonalDriver: High electric-resistance winter heating share in rural counties and environmental cost-recovery riders on investor-owned electric bills.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (up to 60 days if tenant leaves without forwarding notice)
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of landlord's right to retain any portion of deposit if checklist/escrow rules violated

states.peakSeasonalDriver: One of the highest per-household kWh consumption averages in the U.S. (>1,200 kWh/mo) plus storm securitization charges.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Greater of $300 or twice the amount willfully retained plus attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: ISO-New England Standard Offer supply spikes, net-energy billing stranded-cost delivery riders, and long winter heating seasons.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent (21 days for tenancy at will)
states.depositPenalty: Double the wrongfully withheld amount plus attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: BGE gas and electric infrastructure STRIDE surcharges alongside PJM capacity clearing price increases.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (updated effective October 2024)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 3× the wrongfully withheld amount plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Winter LNG fuel dependency across ISO-New England plus Mass Save energy efficiency delivery charges on electric and gas bills.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent
states.depositPenalty: Treble (3×) damages plus 5% interest and attorney fees for escrow or return violations

states.peakSeasonalDriver: DTE and Consumers Energy summer peak-hour pricing (3 PM–7 PM) and Great Lakes winter space heating demand.
states.depositCap: 1.5 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Double the amount retained without timely statutory lawsuit if disputed

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Extended sub-freezing winter heating season driving natural gas costs alongside Cold Weather Rule disconnection protections.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (1% simple annual interest required)
states.depositPenalty: Double the withheld amount plus up to $500 bad-faith penalty

states.peakSeasonalDriver: High cooling degree-days from May through October driving average residential electricity usage above 1,200 kWh per month.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Up to $200 in statutory damages plus actual wrongfully withheld amount

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Ameren seasonal summer/winter rate tiers and infrastructure system replacement surcharges (ISRS) on natural gas bills.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Up to twice the amount wrongfully withheld

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Deep winter heating across sparse mountain corridors and NorthWestern Energy PCCAM power supply cost trackers.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (10 days if no deductions are claimed)
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of deduction rights plus court costs and attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Only U.S. state served entirely by consumer-owned public power utilities, keeping kWh rates well below the U.S. median despite cold winter peaks.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (plus up to 0.25 month pet deposit)
states.depositPenalty: Amount wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees (and 1 month rent penalty for willful noncompliance)

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Intense June–September Las Vegas air-conditioning loads paired with quarterly NV Energy Base Tariff Energy Rate (BTER) fuel updates.
states.depositCap: 3 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Up to an additional sum equal to the entire deposit for bad-faith retention

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Semi-annual ISO-New England default supply rate resets (February and August) and winter fuel-oil/gas heating costs.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent or $100, whichever is greater
states.depositPenalty: Double the amount of the security deposit plus interest

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Annual June BGS (Basic Generation Service) PJM electric supply auction resets and Societal Benefits Charge riders.
states.pucName: New Jersey Board of Public Utilities (NJBPU)
states.depositCap: 1.5 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Double the amount wrongfully withheld plus full court costs and attorney fees

topProviders: PNM (Public Service Company of New Mexico)
states.peakSeasonalDriver: Dry high-desert climate keeps moderate annual kWh usage, though summer PNM tiered blocks and municipal drought water tiers add surcharges.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent for leases under 1 year
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of deduction rights plus $250 statutory civil penalty and attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Downstate Con Edison delivery charges exceeding supply costs, System Benefits Charges, and winter multi-family heating gas tariffs.
states.pucName: New York State Public Service Commission (NYSPSC)
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of entire right to withhold plus up to 2× deposit in punitive damages for willful violation

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Multi-year Duke Energy base rate phase-ins, coal-ash remediation riders, and humid Piedmont summer cooling demand.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent for leases over month-to-month (up to 60 days interim accounting if damages undetermined)
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of right to retain any portion of deposit plus attorney fees for willful noncompliance

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Severe Arctic winter heating loads driving December–March natural gas and electric heat-pump consumption despite low base kWh rates.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (2 months if tenant has felony conviction or judgment)
states.depositPenalty: Up to treble (3×) damages for withholding without reasonable justification

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Variable-rate third-party retail supplier rollovers after introductory offers expire, plus PJM transmission riders.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (5% annual interest if deposit exceeds 1 month's rent and lease >6 months)
states.depositPenalty: Double the amount wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Winter Storm Uri securitization recovery riders on natural gas bills and high July–September cooling loads.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Full return of wrongfully withheld deposit plus court costs (tenant must submit written demand within 6 months)

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Back-to-back PGE and Pacific Power wildfire/grid modernization rate increases paired with rising Portland/metro water & sewer rates.
states.depositCap: No state cap (Portland local ordinances cap at 1 month's rent)
states.depositPenalty: Twice the amount wrongfully withheld

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Quarterly Price-to-Compare (PTC) default electric supply resets and PJM grid capacity cost increases across eastern and western PA.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent in year 1; 1 month's rent in year 2+
states.depositPenalty: Double the difference between deposit and actual damages if landlord misses 30-day deadline

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Sharp winter Last Resort Service (LRS) October–March electric supply hikes and New England natural gas delivery tariffs.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent
states.depositPenalty: Twice the amount wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: High coastal/Midlands summer cooling demand (>1,100 kWh/mo) and Dominion Energy fuel factor adjustments.
states.pucName: Public Service Commission of South Carolina (PSCSC)
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Up to 3× the amount wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Prolonged Northern Plains winter heating cycles paired with wind-rich regional electricity supply keeping kWh rates modest.
states.depositCap: 1 month's rent (itemized statement due within 45 days if requested by tenant)
states.depositPenalty: Up to $200 bad-faith statutory penalty plus full wrongfully withheld amount

states.peakSeasonalDriver: TVA wholesale fuel cost adjustments paired with high residential electric heating/cooling volume (>1,200 kWh/month average).
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (applies to URLTA counties; separate escrow account required)
states.depositPenalty: Forfeiture of right to retain deposit if landlord fails to hold in separate account or provide itemized inspection

states.marketType: Deregulated ERCOT Retail Choice (85% of State)
states.peakSeasonalDriver: ERCOT summer heatwave wholesale volatility, TDU delivery fee hikes (Oncor/CenterPoint), and tiered bill-credit trap plans that spike below 1,000 kWh.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (tenant must supply written forwarding address)
states.depositPenalty: $100 plus 3× the portion wrongfully withheld plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Among the lowest residential electricity rates nationally, though tiered summer cooling blocks (May–September) and winter inversion heating drive bill variance.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Full deposit plus $100 civil penalty and court costs if unreturned within 5 business days of written notice

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Cold New England winters combined with regional ISO-NE transmission fees, partially moderated by GMP battery-storage peak-shaving programs.
states.depositCap: No state cap (Burlington local cap: 1 month's rent)
states.depositPenalty: Double the wrongfully withheld amount plus court costs and attorney fees for willful failure

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Northern Virginia data-center transmission infrastructure riders and Dominion Energy fuel factor adjustments during humid summer months.
states.depositCap: 2 months' rent
states.depositPenalty: Actual damages plus reasonable attorney fees for willful noncompliance

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Columbia River hydropower delivers the lowest kWh rate in the nation, while Seattle/King County municipal sewer & stormwater rates push water bills above the U.S. median.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (written move-in checklist required)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 2× the deposit amount for intentional failure to return or provide documentation

states.peakSeasonalDriver: Expanded coal-plant fuel cost recovery (ENEC) rate cases and higher winter electric heating usage across Appalachian counties.
states.pucName: Public Service Commission of West Virginia (PSCWV)
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (45 days if new tenant moves in earlier)
states.depositPenalty: Up to 1.5× the wrongfully withheld deposit plus reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: We Energies fixed customer facility charges and sustained November–March Great Lakes heating gas consumption.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap
states.depositPenalty: Double pecuniary loss plus court costs and reasonable attorney fees

states.peakSeasonalDriver: High-altitude winter cold snaps driving natural gas consumption while local generation keeps per-kWh electric rates well below the U.S. median.
states.depositCap: No statutory cap (additional 30 days allowed if property damage requires assessment)
states.depositPenalty: Full deposit return plus court costs
